watch.summary: The streamer forgets a esports player's name mid-hype, stops in confusion, and then explosively resumes shouting when he remembers.

beats.what: Creator rapidly hypes up all the team members one by one
Creator stops shouting and realizes he forgot someone's name
He suddenly remembers Bang and screams his name repeatedly
Creator laughs and keeps yelling Bang in celebration

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I missed somebody... I missed someone... BANG!
watch.why: The sudden shift from high-energy hype to total brain lag creates a great comedic pause. His energetic recovery once he remembers the name lands the punchline.
